department: Department of Chemical and Materials Engineering, Newark College of Engineering

deadline.value: The catalog gives no application deadline.

gre_general.value: The Newark College of Engineering makes the GRE optional but strongly recommended for PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: Newark College of Engineering - GRE optional but strongly recommended for all MS and PhD applicants

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog does not state how many admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: Students with a bachelor's degree in materials engineering follow a 36-credit route, and students with a master's follow a 12-credit route.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. students with a recognized Baccalaureate degree in materials engineering or a related field are required to take eight 600-level or 700-level 3-credit courses (24 credits)

also.quote: Ph.D. students with a recognized Master’s degree or equivalent in materials engineering or a related field are required to take four 700-level 3-credit courses (12 credits)

notes: A second Materials Science and Engineering option is administered by the physics department (catalog physics/materials-science-engineering-phd); its rules were not checked separately.
name: Ph.D. in Materials Science and Engineering (materials engineering option)
